subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every weekend, an old man paints pictures on the sidewalk near the train station.”?
options: As buildings change and machines disappear, sounds vanish too.
If resting places disappear, the whole journey becomes harder.
His pictures disappear when it rains, but he keeps painting.
Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「His pictures disappear when it rains, but he keeps painting.」，答案為「His pictures disappear when it rains, but he keeps painting.」。
